integrity: Analytic proof supplied; numerical checker is supplementary. No field calibration or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Two hard-footprint detectors, a perfectly detecting reference, a location-independent fallible secondary detector, one uncertain target, even strictly log-concave target-location density on an unbounded real line. It does not address imperfect reference sensitivity, false calls, bounded fields, unequal footprint sizes or detection-rate precision. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Optimal adjoining footprints for one reference and one fallible wildlife detector
